I'm weighing whether spending everything now is worth the exposure before the next rolls land.

I do have mortgage options and houses I could sell if I land somewhere expensive, and threats from the unbuilt yellow properties are minor by comparison, so I think the safer play is to just keep my cash and end the turn conservatively rather than build the hotel now.
